chapters.title: 1. Migration Strategy Summary & Multi-Axis Gap Matrix
chapters.purpose: Present confirmed assumptions, explicit non-goals, the multi-axis As-Is -> To-Be gap matrix (Language, Framework, Architecture, DB, Cache, Container), and effort/PR distribution across phases.
required_diagrams: Multi-Axis As-Is vs. To-Be Gap Matrix (`Table`: Axis, As-Is, To-Be, Risk, Approach)
PR Effort & Risk Distribution by Phase / Axis (`BarChart` + `KpiCards`)
sorted_data_markdown: - **Executive Migration Summary**: This phased PR execution plan modernizes legacy-billing (Baseline Audit wf-8177454c: Grade C, 66/100) from a broken Java 1.8 / unpinned Spring Boot / cyclic monolith into a deterministic Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.4.x + PostgreSQL 16 (JPA + Flyway) + Redis 7 service organized under Clean Architecture (domain / port / usecase / adapter). Phase 0 resolves the critical Spring Boot 4.2.0 vs Java 8 build crash and establishes JUnit 5 + MockMvc Golden Master tests preserving the strict POST /charge contract (customerId, amountCents, billedCents). Phase 1 severs the BillingController <-> BillingManager cycle and extracts framework-free Java 21 domain records and inbound/outbound Ports. Phase 2 executes OpenRewrite mechanical upgrades and introduces PostgreSQL/Redis/RestClient adapters. Phase 3 hardens inbound @Valid DTOs, removes hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET, and resolves Stakeholder Decision Log quirks (currency == 'USD', fixed 100L retry, controllerPing). Phase 4 hardens Docker (multi-stage non-root eclipse-temurin:21-jre) and GitHub Actions CI before final PNI verification.
- **Confirmed Assumption**: Target runtime & framework pinned to Java 21 LTS + Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM (Jakarta EE 10, JUnit 5 Jupiter, Mockito, JaCoCo).
- **Confirmed Assumption**: Persistence externalized to PostgreSQL 16 via Spring Data JPA + Flyway versioned DDL migrations.
- **Confirmed Assumption**: Process-local BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE externalized to Redis 7 (StringRedisTemplate / Spring Data Redis) with explicit TTL.
- **Confirmed Assumption**: Strict external HTTP JSON contract compatibility preserved on POST /charge (customerId, amountCents, billedCents).

- **Confirmed Assumption**: Ambiguous legacy quirks (controllerPing key, String == comparisons, fixed 100L retry charge) isolated into Stakeholder Decision Log under ask_human policy prior to Phase 3.
- **Explicit Non-Goal (Out of Scope)**: No microservice decomposition or multi-artifact repository split (retain single deployable Maven artifact).
- **Explicit Non-Goal (Out of Scope)**: No Kafka or RabbitMQ event bus introduction in this migration wave.
- **Explicit Non-Goal (Out of Scope)**: No breaking URL path changes or v2 API versioning on /charge.

- **Axis `[language_runtime]` Java 1.8 -> Java 21 LTS & Legacy Date/Collection Cleanup (`critical`)**: As-Is=`pom.xml targets Java 1.8 (colliding with Java 11 java.net.http in GatewayClient and resolved Spring Boot 4.2.0 bytecode 61.0); LegacyDateHelper uses non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat, java.util.Date, and Vector.` -> To-Be=`Java 21 LTS toolchain with Maven Wrapper (mvnw), immutable Java 21 records, java.time.Instant/DateTimeFormatter, and List/ArrayList.` | Approach: Fix toolchain in Phase 0, run OpenRewrite UpgradeToJava21 recipe in Phase 2, and replace LegacyDateHelper with Clock/java.time in Wave 1.

- **Axis `[framework]` Unpinned Spring Boot / javax.servlet / JUnit 4 -> Spring Boot 3.4.x (Jakarta EE 10) + JUnit 5 (`critical`)**: As-Is=`spring-boot-starter-web:LATEST without BOM, javax.servlet:4.0.1, JUnit 4.13.2 assertion-free test, @Autowired field injection, catch-all @RequestMapping, missing spring-tx.` -> To-Be=`Pinned Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM, jakarta.servlet / jakarta.validation, Spring RestClient, constructor DI, @PostMapping('/charge'), JUnit 5 Jupiter + Mockito + JaCoCo.` | Approach: Pin Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM in Phase 0, apply OpenRewrite UpgradeSpringBoot_3_4 and JUnit4to5Migration in dedicated mechanical PRs during Phase 2.

- **Axis `[architecture_pattern]` Cyclic Layered Monolith -> Clean Architecture (domain / port / usecase / adapter) (`high`)**: As-Is=`Runtime circular dependency BillingController <-> BillingManager (via @Autowired circularController), cognitive=56 god method (8 params), raw Map/List payloads.` -> To-Be=`Strict inward-only Clean Architecture: framework-free domain records & TaxPolicy, inbound/outbound Port interfaces, pure UseCase orchestrators, and isolated inbound/outbound Adapters.` | Approach: Follow topological Waves 1->4: migrate Wave 1 leaves to domain, sever BillingManager -> BillingController back-edge via explicit DTO inputs in Wave 3, then wrap adapters.

- **Axis `[database_persistence]` Broken private @Transactional Stub -> PostgreSQL 16 + Spring Data JPA + Flyway (`high`)**: As-Is=`BillingManager.saveAuditTrail() uses private @Transactional (bypassed by Spring AOP self-invocation and missing spring-tx) and prints to System.out.` -> To-Be=`Outbound BillingAuditRepositoryPort implemented by JpaBillingAuditAdapter backed by PostgreSQL 16 and Flyway V1__create_billing_audit.sql.` | Approach: Extract BillingAuditRepositoryPort in Phase 1 (initially backed by an in-memory stub), then wire PostgreSQL JPA + Flyway adapter verified by Testcontainers in Phase 2.

- **Axis `[cache_state]` Static HashMap INVOICE_CACHE & Mutable Singleton Field -> Stateless + Redis 7 TTL (`high`)**: As-Is=`Unsynchronized static raw Map BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE and mutable singleton field BillingController.channel cause cross-request data races.` -> To-Be=`Stateless controllers/usecases with InvoiceCachePort implemented by RedisInvoiceCacheAdapter (Redis 7 StringRedisTemplate with explicit TTL).` | Approach: Remove BillingController.channel in Wave 3 (passing HTTP method as a local parameter if controllerPing is retained) and move INVOICE_CACHE behind InvoiceCachePort -> Redis 7 in Phase 2.

- **Axis `[auth_security]` Hardcoded Secret, Unbounded HTTP Client & Unvalidated ANY /charge -> Hardened Boundary (`critical`)**: As-Is=`Hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET in GatewayClient.java:13, System.getenv without typed config, unbounded HttpClient.newHttpClient(), unauthenticated ANY /charge with raw Map, unpinned CVE-2022-22965 range.` -> To-Be=`@ConfigurationProperties secret & endpoint binding, timeout-bounded Spring RestClient adapter, @PostMapping('/charge') with @Valid ChargeRequest DTO, authentication filter, and SLF4J structured logging.` | Approach: Pin BOM in Phase 0 (clearing unpinned CVE range), replace GatewayClient with PaymentGatewayPort + RestClient in Phase 2, and enforce @Valid DTO + secret externalization in Phase 3.

- **Axis `[container_cicd]` Broken openjdk:latest Root Dockerfile & Privileged CI -> Hardened Non-Root Temurin 21 + Pinned CI (`critical`)**: As-Is=`Dockerfile FROM openjdk:latest (removed on Docker Hub, runs as root, no .dockerignore, no HEALTHCHECK); .github/workflows/build.yml uses pull_request_target + actions/checkout@main without permissions.` -> To-Be=`Multi-stage eclipse-temurin:21-jdk / eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine non-root image with .dockerignore and Actuator HEALTHCHECK; GitHub Actions pull_request workflow with contents: read and full commit-SHA pinning.` | Approach: Harden CI and multi-stage Dockerfile in Phase 4 (or immediately as an unblocking P0 PR alongside Phase 0 build fix), then re-run PNI full audit + Trivy + DAST.

chapters.title: 2. Target Architecture, Refactoring Waves & Data Contracts
chapters.purpose: Visualize the To-Be layered / Port & Adapter architecture (`ClassDiagram`), topological Wave 1..4 refactoring order with cycle-cut edges (`Roadmap`), and implicit I/O contract -> typed DTO mappings.
required_diagrams: To-Be Target Architecture & Port/Adapter Layer Diagram (`ClassDiagram`)
Leaf-First Topological Wave 1..4 Order & Implicit Contract Mapping (`Roadmap` + `Table`)
sorted_data_markdown: - **Target Architecture Pattern**: `Clean Architecture (Hexagonal / Ports & Adapters) on Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.4` — Four concentric rings with strict inward-only dependencies: pure Java 21 domain records/policies at the core, inbound/outbound Port interfaces, framework-free UseCase orchestrators, and swappable inbound web and outbound gateway/PostgreSQL/Redis adapters.
- **Dependency Rule**: domain MUST NOT import org.springframework.*, jakarta.persistence.*, java.net.http.*, or Redis libraries.
- **Dependency Rule**: usecase depends ONLY on domain and port interfaces; never on adapter.in.* or adapter.out.*.
- **Dependency Rule**: adapter.in.web translates strict external HTTP POST /charge JSON DTOs into domain commands and invokes inbound ports.
- **Dependency Rule**: adapter.out.* implements outbound ports (PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, BillingAuditRepositoryPort) with explicit timeouts, TTLs, and @Transactional boundaries.

- **Target Layer `Domain Layer` (`com.example.billing.domain`)**: Pure Java 21 immutable record models (Invoice, Money, BillingSummary), Currency/InvoiceStatus enums, and deterministic TaxPolicy. | allowed=[], forbidden=['org.springframework.*', 'jakarta.persistence.*', 'jakarta.servlet.*', 'java.net.http.*']

- **Target Layer `Port Layer` (`com.example.billing.port`)**: Inbound use-case contracts (ChargeCustomerUseCase, ProcessBatchBillingUseCase) and outbound SPI contracts (PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, BillingAuditRepositoryPort). | allowed=['Domain Layer'], forbidden=['org.springframework.web.*', 'jakarta.persistence.*']

- **Target Layer `UseCase Layer` (`com.example.billing.usecase`)**: Pure billing orchestration services (ProcessBatchBillingService) coordinating tax calculation, bounded gateway retries, cache updates, and audit persistence without upward Controller references. | allowed=['Domain Layer', 'Port Layer'], forbidden=['com.example.billing.adapter.*', 'org.springframework.web.*']

- **Target Layer `Inbound Web Adapter` (`com.example.billing.adapter.in.web`)**: Stateless BillingController (@PostMapping('/charge')), @Valid ChargeRequest/ChargeResponse DTOs preserving strict external JSON keys, and exception mapping. | allowed=['Port Layer', 'Domain Layer'], forbidden=['com.example.billing.adapter.out.*']

- **Target Layer `Outbound Infrastructure Adapters` (`com.example.billing.adapter.out`)**: RestClientPaymentGatewayAdapter (connect/read timeouts + @ConfigurationProperties), JpaBillingAuditAdapter (PostgreSQL 16 + Flyway + public @Transactional), and RedisInvoiceCacheAdapter (Redis 7 with TTL). | allowed=['Port Layer', 'Domain Layer'], forbidden=['com.example.billing.adapter.in.*']

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/model/InvoiceRecord.java` (`InvoiceRecord`) -> `[Domain Layer]` `com.example.billing.domain.Invoice / Money` (Pure Java 21 Domain Record): Wave 1 leaf: convert class to immutable Java 21 record with non-negative invariant validation.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/util/LegacyDateHelper.java` (`LegacyDateHelper`) -> `[Domain Layer]` `com.example.billing.domain.BillingPeriodFormatter` (Pure Domain Clock/Time Policy): Wave 1 leaf: replace SimpleDateFormat, java.util.Date, and synchronized Vector with thread-safe DateTimeFormatter, java.time.Clock, and List<String>.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/client/GatewayClient.java` (`GatewayClient.sendCharge`) -> `[Outbound Infrastructure Adapters]` `com.example.billing.adapter.out.gateway.RestClientPaymentGatewayAdapter` (Outbound Gateway Adapter implementing PaymentGatewayPort): Wave 2: externalize LEGACY_PAYMENT_URL & GATEWAY_SECRET into @ConfigurationProperties, enforce connect/read timeouts via Spring RestClient, and log via SLF4J.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java` (`BillingManager.processBatchBilling`) -> `[UseCase Layer]` `com.example.billing.usecase.ProcessBatchBillingService` (Inbound UseCase Implementation (ProcessBatchBillingUseCase)): Wave 3 cycle cut: sever @Autowired circularController, decompose cognitive=56 / 8-param method into BillingCommand + TaxPolicy, and delegate to PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, and BillingAuditRepositoryPort.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java` (`BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE`) -> `[Outbound Infrastructure Adapters]` `com.example.billing.adapter.out.cache.RedisInvoiceCacheAdapter` (Outbound Cache Adapter implementing InvoiceCachePort): Replace unsynchronized static raw HashMap with Redis 7 StringRedisTemplate and explicit key TTL.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java` (`BillingManager.saveAuditTrail`) -> `[Outbound Infrastructure Adapters]` `com.example.billing.adapter.out.persistence.JpaBillingAuditAdapter` (Outbound Persistence Adapter implementing BillingAuditRepositoryPort): Replace ineffective private @Transactional System.out stub with PostgreSQL 16 Spring Data JPA repository + Flyway DDL and public @Transactional boundary.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java` (`BillingController.chargeCustomer`) -> `[Inbound Web Adapter]` `com.example.billing.adapter.in.web.BillingController` (Inbound HTTP Adapter): Wave 3/4: remove mutable singleton 'channel' field, enforce @PostMapping('/charge') with @Valid ChargeRequest DTO, preserve strict JSON response keys (customerId, billedCents), and wire ChargeCustomerUseCase via constructor DI.

- **Component Mapping**: `src/main/java/com/example/billing/BillingApp.java` (`BillingApp`) -> `[Outbound Infrastructure Adapters]` `com.example.billing.BillingApp + BillingConfiguration` (Composition Root): Wave 4: enable @ConfigurationPropertiesScan and Spring Boot Actuator health probes.

- **Wave 1: Leaf Models, Value Objects & Pure Utilities**: modules=['examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/model/InvoiceRecord.java', 'examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/util/LegacyDateHelper.java'] — Zero internal dependencies and zero external I/O; safe to migrate/type first as Domain core.

- **Wave 2: Outbound Infrastructure & Gateway/DB Clients**: modules=['examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/client/GatewayClient.java'] — Depends only on Wave 1 leaves; prime candidates for Outbound Port & Adapter extraction.

- **Wave 3: Strongly Connected Components (Cycle Cut Targets)**: modules=['examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java', 'examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java'] — Bidirectional circular dependencies that must be severed before layered/Clean Arch isolation.

- **Wave 4: Application Orchestrators, Controllers & Entrypoints**: modules=['examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/BillingApp.java'] — Top-level inbound adapters and boot entrypoints wired after Domain, Ports, and Adapters exist.

- **Cycle Cut**: `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java -> examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java` — Break upward/cyclic back-reference `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java -> examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java` by passing required scalar/DTO inputs explicitly or inverting dependency via a Port interface.
- **Implicit Contract `ANY /charge`**: inputs=['customerId:string(default=anon)', 'amountCents:integer(default=500)'], outputs=['controllerPing:string', 'customerId:string', 'billedCents:integer']

chapters.title: 3. Stakeholder Decision Log (Spec vs. Bug)
chapters.purpose: Isolate legacy quirks ('Spec vs. Bug' under Hyrum's Law) for Product Owner sign-off so Phase 0-2 infrastructure upgrades never silently alter billing, auth, or external response contracts.
required_diagrams: Spec vs. Bug Stakeholder Decision Matrix (`Table`: ID, Location, Current Behavior, Impact, Recommended)
Decision Handling Workflow Across Phase 0 Characterization -> Phase 3 Sign-Off (`CardList` / `Roadmap`)
sorted_data_markdown: - **`DEC-JAVA-01` (`src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:55`)**: Current=`Lines 52, 55, 57 compare status == "PAID", currency == "USD", and currency == "JPY" using Java reference equality (==), which works only for interned literals and silently skips tax/PAID checks for deserialized HTTP strings.` | Impact=`Switching to .equals() / typed enums will cause non-interned 'USD'/'JPY' inputs to start incurring 8%/10% tax and 'PAID' invoices to be skipped — potentially changing billedCents for existing callers.` | Recommended=`Fix to typed Currency/InvoiceStatus enums (.equals()) in Phase 3 after verifying whether any caller relies on untaxed deserialized strings.`

- **`DEC-JAVA-02` (`src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:67`)**: Current=`When rec.getAmountCents() <= 0 and forceRetry is true, BillingManager loops up to maxRetries calling gatewayClient.sendCharge(customerId, 100L) and adds a hardcoded 100L cent fee.` | Impact=`Changing or rejecting non-positive amounts alters retry fee revenue/ledger reconciliation for zero-amount invoice payloads.` | Recommended=`Confirm with billing product owners whether 100L is an intentional minimum authorization hold or a legacy bug before modifying in Phase 3.`

- **`DEC-JAVA-03` (`src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:81`)**: Current=`When circularController != null && extraContext != null, response Map conditionally injects internal diagnostic key 'controllerPing' containing mutable BillingController.lastChannel().` | Impact=`Dropping 'controllerPing' breaks any downstream monitoring script checking that diagnostic key, whereas keeping it requires passing request.getMethod() as a stateless parameter instead of a cyclic bean.` | Recommended=`Confirm whether any client reads 'controllerPing'; if needed under strict compatibility, pass HTTP method as a request-scoped parameter (zero shared state) and deprecate it.`

- **`DEC-JAVA-04` (`src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:83`)**: Current=`Empty catch (Exception e) {} silently swallows audit trail and cache failures, returning HTTP 200 even when persistence fails.` | Impact=`Propagating persistence/cache exceptions will change failure responses from silent HTTP 200 to HTTP 500/503 unless graceful fallback is defined.` | Recommended=`Log all exceptions via SLF4J with correlation ID; fail-fast on PostgreSQL audit write errors while degrading gracefully (warn + metric) on Redis cache misses.`

chapters.title: 4. 5-Phase Gated Execution Roadmap
chapters.purpose: Define the 5-Phase Gated Execution Pipeline (Phase 0 Characterization -> Phase 1 Cycle/Port Extraction -> Phase 2 Codemod & DB/Cache Adapters -> Phase 3 Typed DTO & Approved Fixes -> Phase 4 Cutover) with strict exit criteria and rollback/coexistence conditions.
required_diagrams: Phase Gate Exit Criteria & Rollback / Coexistence Matrix (`Table`)
sorted_data_markdown: - **Phase 0 — Phase 0 — Green Build Recovery & Golden Master Characterization Harness**: Objective=Unblock broken Maven/Docker compilation (Java 1.8 vs Spring Boot 4.2.0 crash) with minimal behavioral edits and lock POST /charge contracts with JUnit 5 + MockMvc tests. | Tasks=['Pin Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM and Java 21 compiler target in pom.xml and commit Maven Wrapper (mvnw).', 'Fix javax.servlet -> jakarta.servlet import in BillingController.java to compile cleanly under Spring Boot 3.4.', 'Replace assertion-free BillingManagerTest.testSmokeRun with JUnit 5 + MockMvc Golden Master tests pinning POST /charge (customerId, amountCents, billedCents).'] | Exit Criteria=['./mvnw test succeeds offline inside Docker with >=80% JaCoCo line coverage on existing billing flows.', 'Golden Master tests lock all implicit POST /charge input/output keys before structural refactoring.'] | Rollback=Single reversible build PR; zero runtime schema or endpoint contract changes.

- **Phase 1 — Phase 1 — Cycle Cut & Clean Architecture Domain / Port Extraction**: Objective=Execute Wave 1 (leaf models/time utils) and Wave 3 cycle cut to sever BillingController <-> BillingManager and establish framework-free domain, port, and usecase packages. | Tasks=['Migrate InvoiceRecord and LegacyDateHelper to pure Java 21 domain records and DateTimeFormatter/Clock (Wave 1).', 'Define inbound (ChargeCustomerUseCase, ProcessBatchBillingUseCase) and outbound (PaymentGatewayPort, InvoiceCachePort, BillingAuditRepositoryPort) Port interfaces.', 'Sever @Autowired circularController in BillingManager, remove mutable BillingController.channel, and wrap existing in-memory cache/audit behind temporary adapters.'] | Exit Criteria=['Zero circular dependencies (AstFacts.circular_dependencies == 0) and zero @Autowired field injections.', 'All Phase 0 Golden Master characterization tests pass unchanged.'] | Rollback=Behavior-preserving refactor using in-memory adapter shims; safe to revert per PR.

- **Phase 2 — Phase 2 — OpenRewrite Codemods & PostgreSQL 16 / Redis 7 / RestClient Adapters**: Objective=Run deterministic OpenRewrite upgrades and swap temporary shims for production PostgreSQL 16 (JPA + Flyway), Redis 7 (TTL), and timeout-bounded Spring RestClient adapters. | Tasks=['Apply OpenRewrite UpgradeToJava21, UpgradeSpringBoot_3_4, and JUnit4to5Migration in a dedicated mechanical PR.', 'Implement JpaBillingAuditAdapter with Flyway V1__create_billing_audit.sql and public @Transactional boundary (replacing broken private @Transactional stub).', 'Implement RedisInvoiceCacheAdapter (explicit TTL) and RestClientPaymentGatewayAdapter (explicit connect/read timeouts) verified via Testcontainers + WireMock.'] | Exit Criteria=['All PostgreSQL Flyway migrations, Redis TTL integration tests, and RestClient timeout tests pass via Testcontainers/WireMock.', 'Zero missing I/O timeouts and zero static mutable state.'] | Rollback=Feature-toggle persistence/cache adapter beans via Spring profiles during staging soak test.

- **Phase 3 — Phase 3 — Typed @Valid DTOs, Security Hardening & Approved Decision Log Fixes**: Objective=Harden the HTTP boundary, eliminate hardcoded secrets, and execute stakeholder-approved Decision Log fixes (DEC-JAVA-01..04). | Tasks=["Replace raw Map payload and catch-all @RequestMapping with @PostMapping('/charge') and @Valid ChargeRequest/ChargeResponse Java records preserving strict JSON keys.", 'Delete hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET literal in GatewayClient, rotate credentials, and bind via @ConfigurationProperties.', 'Apply stakeholder-approved DEC-JAVA-01..04 resolutions (enum/.equals() comparisons, configurable retry amount, controllerPing disposition, SLF4J + error propagation).'] | Exit Criteria=["Zero hardcoded secrets, zero raw Map/List generics, zero @SuppressWarnings('unchecked'), and passing authentication/validation MockMvc tests.", 'All 4 Stakeholder Decision Log items signed off and covered by unit/integration tests.'] | Rollback=Guard behavioral DEC-JAVA-01/02 changes with explicit canary metrics before full rollout.

- **Phase 4 — Phase 4 — Container / CI Hardening & Final PNI Acceptance Audit**: Objective=Replace broken root openjdk:latest Dockerfile and privileged pull_request_target CI, then pass full PNI v2 audit + Trivy + live DAST acceptance gates. | Tasks=['Create multi-stage eclipse-temurin:21-jdk / eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine non-root Dockerfile with .dockerignore and Spring Boot Actuator /actuator/health HEALTHCHECK.', 'Update .github/workflows/build.yml to pull_request trigger, explicit permissions: { contents: read }, and commit-SHA-pinned actions, plus add LICENSE, SECURITY.md, .gitignore, and Dependabot.', 'Re-run PNI java_api_spring_messy audit including Docker runtime verification, Trivy SCA, and live HTTP DAST pentest.'] | Exit Criteria=['Docker image builds cleanly with 0 HIGH/CRITICAL Dockerfile misconfigs and 0 unpinned app CVEs.', 'Live DAST pentest (.pni/pentests/examples/java/api_spring_messy) boots cleanly and passes with 0 CRITICAL/HIGH findings; overall PNI score >= 85 (Grade A/S).'] | Rollback=Blue/green container deployment with /actuator/health readiness probe rollback trigger.

chapters.title: 5. Automated Codemods & Boundary Adapter Design
chapters.purpose: Separate deterministic mechanical codemods (OpenRewrite / Rector / Ruff) from manual Port & Adapter extractions (Redis cache externalization, PostgreSQL/PDO persistence, HTTP client timeouts).
required_diagrams: Automated Codemod vs. Manual Refactoring Breakdown & Recipes (`BarChart` + `Table`)
Boundary Touchpoints (State / DB / Outbound HTTP) -> Port & Adapter Design (`Table`)
sorted_data_markdown: - **Blocker `BLK-01` (`critical`) (`examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/client/GatewayClient.java:4`)**: Java 11+ 'java.net.http' API imported while declared target is Java 1.8

- **Blocker `BLK-02` (`high`) (`com.example.billing.controller.BillingController:None`)**: Bidirectional circular dependency across modules: com.example.billing.controller.BillingController <-> com.example.billing.service.BillingManager <-> com.example.billing.controller.BillingController

- **Blocker `BLK-03` (`medium`) (`examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:12`)**: Undeclared or dev-scoped import `org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional`: Spring transaction API imported without 'spring-tx' or data/jdbc starter in manifest

- **Codemod `openrewrite` — `org.openrewrite.java.migrate.UpgradeToJava21`**: Upgrade Java Compiler Target & Standard Library Idioms to Java 21 LTS (files=6) — Automates Java 8->21 POM properties, diamond operators, and deprecated JDK API replacements.

- **Codemod `openrewrite` — `org.openrewrite.java.spring.boot3.UpgradeSpringBoot_3_4`**: Migrate Spring Boot 2.x (javax.*) to Spring Boot 3.4 (jakarta.*) & Constructor DI (files=6) — Rewrites javax.servlet/persistence imports to jakarta.* and updates Spring Boot starters.

- **Codemod `openrewrite` — `org.openrewrite.java.testing.junit5.JUnit4to5Migration`**: Migrate JUnit 4 @Test / Assertions to JUnit 5 Jupiter (files=1) — Converts org.junit.Test and Assert.* calls to org.junit.jupiter.api.* deterministically.

- **Boundary Touchpoint `[in_memory_state]` `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java:20` (`channel`)**: Mutable instance field `channel` on singleton Spring bean -> Convert bean to stateless; pass request-scoped context or externalize state to Redis/DB

- **Boundary Touchpoint `[in_memory_state]` `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:17` (`INVOICE_CACHE`)**: Process-local static mutable collection (INVOICE_CACHE) -> Externalize into Cache/State Port (e.g. Redis / Caffeine Adapter with explicit TTL)

- **Boundary Touchpoint `[persistence_db]` `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:91` (`@Transactional`)**: @Transactional persistence boundary without dedicated Repository Port -> Extract Repository Port interface and move transaction/JPA/JDBC logic to Outbound Persistence Adapter

- **Boundary Touchpoint `[external_http_rpc]` `examples/java/api_spring_messy/src/main/java/com/example/billing/client/GatewayClient.java:22` (`HttpClient.newHttpClient`)**: Direct outbound HTTP client invocation (HttpClient.newHttpClient) -> Abstract behind Outbound Gateway Port with explicit connect/read timeout Adapter
